name: Madarihat–Phuntsholing National Highway
significance: NH 317A is a branch of NH 317. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Madarihat to Phuntsholing, and it meets NH 317 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 317 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Birpara to Alipurduar
